title: A network failure on save shows Failed to save part and keeps the dialog
custom_steps:
1. New Inventory Part: fill Description, a new Part Number, Category and Cost.
  2. DevTools > Network > Offline, then click Save.
  3. Set Network back to Online and click Save again.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • Toast "Failed to save part." with "Please try again."
  • The dialog stays open with the typed values; Save is clickable again.
  • No part is created (search the number).

Step 3:

  • The part saves.
